decisions.reason: As a low-carrying-cost dental consumable that was given dedicated website support in both 2018 and 2019, it still looks like a worthwhile option to retain in the portfolio unless later sales proved clearly weak.

This thermoforming material fits closely with the firm's dental laboratory workflow business and digital-production positioning, so a large established manufacturer would usually keep it unless performance had clearly disappointed.
Because it appears to be a smaller add-on material with less visible emphasis, it is more exposed to pruning, but its likely low carrying cost still makes keeping the option open reasonable.

Given the weaker website prominence and the nearby disappearance of another earmold line, management would likely view this hearing-protection niche as a less attractive option and reallocate resources to stronger core products or new developments.
